# State Management Checklist: SPEC-013A1 - GitHub Sync Automation and Poller Lifecycle

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for durable lifecycle state, run history separation, explicit state transitions, flag-off manual-sync preservation, and rollback-safe auditability.
**Created**: 2026-05-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are lifecycle control state and per-attempt run history explicitly defined as separate requirement surfaces? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-013, Plan §Migration Plan, Data Model §Poller Lifecycle Control, Data Model §Sync Run]
- [x] CHK002 Are enablement, interval, bounds, backoff, lease, cursor, disabled reason, counters, skipped outcomes, and partial-run fields all named in the control-state requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, Data Model §Poller Lifecycle Control]

- [x] CHK005 Does the spec define state requirements for same-scope manual and automatic overlap in both directions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-019, Contract §POST /api/github/sync]

## Notes

- CHK007 was the only initial state-management gap. It is resolved by adding explicit skipped owner, skipped non-owner, and ownership-unresolved terminal lifecycle transition semantics to the data model and tightening the spec/plan traceability.
- Re-run validation completed after remediation. No new state-management gap markers were found.
